name: OSINT — Image & Video Geolocation
description: Geolocate imagery from converging spatial clues while resisting lookalike-location confirmation bias.

tasks.name: Preserve and decompose media
tasks.objective: Preserve original media, extract representative video frames and available metadata, note crops/compression/edit boundaries, and record known publication context without treating uploader claims as fact.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Frames and metadata remain linked to the original media and timestamps.

tasks.name: Inventory location clues
tasks.objective: Catalog scripts/languages, road markings/signage, architecture, utility poles, vegetation, geology, terrain, water, transit, businesses, skylines, shadows, weather, celestial cues, camera direction, and negative clues. Separate robust clues from generic visual resemblance.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Clues include discriminating negatives as well as apparent matches.

tasks.name: Generate candidate areas
tasks.objective: Use clue combinations to generate candidate countries/regions/locations through maps, gazetteers, search, street-level imagery, satellite imagery, terrain, business directories, transport data, and historical imagery where lawful and available.

acceptanceCriteria.description: At least one serious alternative candidate is retained until disproven.

tasks.name: Match geometry
tasks.objective: Test candidate locations against road/building geometry, horizon/terrain profiles, landmarks, relative object placement, camera viewpoint, distances, and satellite/street imagery. Use multiple independent correspondences rather than one landmark-shaped coincidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A claimed match uses several spatially consistent correspondences.

tasks.name: Constrain time and orientation
tasks.objective: When useful, test sun/shadow geometry, seasonal vegetation, weather, construction state, signage history, lighting, celestial features, and archive/street-view dates to constrain camera orientation and capture window. State wide ranges when precision is unsupported.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Chronolocation precision matches the actual evidence.

tasks.name: Falsify candidate
tasks.objective: Search deliberately for lookalike sites and contradictions: impossible shadows, absent structures, wrong road geometry, changed storefronts, terrain mismatch, reversed orientation, or imagery taken from another date. For private individuals, report no more location precision than the legitimate research purpose requires.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The winning candidate survives explicit comparison against alternatives.

tasks.name: Package geolocation proof
tasks.objective: Provide location at justified precision, optional time window, annotated correspondences, maps/reference imagery, source dates, uncertainty, rejected alternatives, and reproducible reasoning without exposing unnecessary sensitive private-location detail.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Another investigator can reproduce the match from the recorded clues and sources.
